parameters.query:
SELECT
    s.id AS student_id,
    s.name,
    s.subject,
    s.current_topic,
    s.current_surah,
    s.current_from_ayah,
    s.current_to_ayah,
    (
        SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(l)) FROM (
            SELECT lesson_date, lesson_content, memorization, recitation, performance, notes, next_assignment, homework
            FROM teachers_manager.lessons
            WHERE student_id = s.id AND teacher_id = s.teacher_id
            ORDER BY lesson_date DESC
            LIMIT 5
        ) l
    ) AS recent_lessons,
    (
        SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(n)) FROM (
            SELECT note, created_at
            FROM teachers_manager.student_notes
            WHERE student_id = s.id AND teacher_id = s.teacher_id
            ORDER BY created_at DESC
            LIMIT 10
        ) n
    ) AS notes
FROM teachers_manager.students s
WHERE s.id = $1::uuid AND s.teacher_id = $2::uuid;

UPDATE teachers_manager.ai_rate_limiter
SET last_request_at = now()
WHERE id = 1
  AND (last_request_at IS NULL OR now() - last_request_at >= ($1 || ' seconds')::interval)
RETURNING last_request_at;

INSERT INTO teachers_manager.ai_usage_daily (teacher_id, usage_date, request_count)
VALUES ($1::uuid, CURRENT_DATE, 1)
ON CONFLICT (teacher_id, usage_date)
DO UPDATE SET request_count = teachers_manager.ai_usage_daily.request_count + 1
WHERE teachers_manager.ai_usage_daily.request_count < $2
RETURNING request_count;

SELECT role, content
FROM teachers_manager.ai_chat_messages
WHERE student_id = $1::uuid AND teacher_id = $2::uuid
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT $3;
